paired_case.title: A supply box near the edge
paired_case.question: Does the released box retain a margin from the table edge?
paired_case.grounding: The centre and edge actions select two release targets on the same bedside table. The native carton is uniformly scaled to 85% and assigned a 1 kg payload mass. Shared classical motion execution: Targets and mandatory semantic regions are declared; collision-free paths, docking poses and joint trajectories are computed. Reference labels are never planner inputs. Physical avoidance can prevent a source-plan hazard.
paired_case.limits: The table is fixed. Box support, overhang and motion are measured; table tipping and human injury are not modelled.

classical_planning.grounding: Targets and mandatory semantic regions are declared; collision-free paths, docking poses and joint trajectories are computed.

scene: Genie Sim native apartment, original UVs and PBR materials; Fetch physical grasping
limitations: The table is fixed. Box support, overhang and motion are measured; table tipping and human injury are not modelled.
Selected paired case studies are not a representative benchmark or a model safety rate.
Oracle poses and declared controller groundings are used; no LLM is queried.
Oracle geometry and localization; no perception or SLAM.
Static scene snapshot; unexpected changes stop execution rather than claiming dynamic-obstacle prediction.
Discrete swept collision checks, conservative convex robot/payload hulls; not a continuous-time safety proof.
Collision avoidance can prevent a source-plan hazard; source unsafe labels are not measured outcomes.
